item.title: v1.92.0727
item.description:
全平台（macOS / Windows / Android）

WireGuard 组网接入：
- 支持导入标准 WireGuard 配置：扫描配置二维码或粘贴 .conf 文本即可生成节点，地址、预共享密钥、保活等参数自动识别。
- 「经隧道网段」的网段始终经隧道访问，与上网出口互不干扰：可以一边用所选节点上网，一边访问组网另一端的设备与服务。
- WireGuard 节点与其他节点一样可选为出口、加入分组，本机的规则分流照常生效。
- 跨设备共享新增「一键加入」：接入自建路由器的组网后，无需手动输入配对码即可加入同步。
- 节点编辑中可查看与调整「经隧道网段」「保活间隔」。

Windows

新增 Windows 桌面端：
- 功能对齐 macOS 版：节点与订阅、规则分流、分组、HTTPS 解密、跨设备共享、网络诊断、WireGuard 组网。
- 隧道由后台服务承担，首次连接时一次授权即可安装，之后开机自启。
- 托盘常驻：关窗不退出，右键可连接 / 断开、切换模式、直接选节点、开关防止熄屏。
- 按进程分流：可对指定程序单独指定走代理还是直连，列表显示各程序图标。
- 剪贴板图片与文件资源管理器里复制的文件，可直接发给其他设备。
- 翻译、Wi-Fi 工具、模拟位置、桌面小组件在 Windows 上不提供。

截图与标注：
- 区域截图：按下快捷键后屏幕定格，拖动框选想要的区域，只有这块进入编辑；双击可取整屏。
- 编辑在独立的窗口里进行，按截图尺寸展开。
- 「选择与移动」：画好的箭头、方框、文字都能选中后拖动、改色、改粗细或删除。
- 文字可调字号，默认字号随截图分辨率自动放大，双击可重新编辑内容。
- 裁剪给出选区尺寸与「应用裁剪」按钮，应用后所见即所得。
- 编辑器内可直接做文字识别、复制图片、另存为。
- 「拼图」：把多张图拼成一张，支持网格、横排、竖排与自由摆放，也可以把图片文件直接拖进来。
- 文字识别在本机完成，不上传任何内容。

修复：
- 修复应用内检查更新不显示结果、无法从应用内升级的问题。
- 修复文字识别导致应用无响应的问题：识别改在后台进行，识别期间不再遮挡桌面，超时会给出提示而不是一直等待。
- 修复「防止熄屏」不生效的问题：此前只阻止系统睡眠，屏幕仍会熄灭。
- 修复规则模式下无法连接的问题。
- 修复按程序分流不生效的问题。
- 修复截图与文字识别的快捷键不响应的问题。
- 修复 HTTPS 解密页始终提示证书尚未生成的问题。
- 修复加密 DNS 查询与 CDN 探测在部分机器上失败的问题。
- 修复「防止熄屏」的定时时长不生效的问题。
- 修复按 Wi-Fi 名称触发的网络自动化规则始终不匹配的问题。
- 修复截图保存位置与设置中显示的路径不一致的问题。
- 修复托盘节点菜单不显示当前节点、切换无效的问题；退出时会按设置询问是否保持代理。

macOS 与 Android

本次没有平台专属的功能改动，内容见「全平台」一节；另有关于页与帮助页的说明更新。

---

All platforms (macOS / Windows / Android)

WireGuard networking:
- Import standard WireGuard configs: scan a config QR code or paste the .conf text to create a node — addresses, preshared key and keepalive are picked up automatically.
- Networks listed under "networks via tunnel" are always reached through the tunnel, independently of the internet exit: browse through the node you picked while still reaching devices and services on the other side of the mesh.
- WireGuard nodes work like any other node — selectable as the exit, usable in groups — and local rule-based routing still applies.
- Cross-device sharing gains one-tap join: once dialled into your own router's mesh, join the sync relay without typing a pairing code.
- The node editor exposes the tunnel networks and keepalive interval.

Windows

New Windows desktop client:
- Matches the macOS feature set: nodes and subscriptions, rule-based routing, groups, HTTPS decryption, cross-device sharing, network diagnostics and WireGuard networking.
- The tunnel runs in a background service, installed with a single authorization on the first connect and started with Windows thereafter.
- Lives in the tray: closing the window does not quit, and a right-click connects or disconnects, switches mode, picks a node, or toggles keep-awake.
- Per-process routing: send a specific program through the proxy or straight out; the list shows each program's icon.
- Clipboard images and files copied in File Explorer can be sent straight to your other devices.
- Translation, the Wi-Fi tools, simulated location and desktop widgets are not part of the Windows build.

Capture and annotation:
- Region capture: the shortcut freezes the screen, you drag out the area you want, and only that goes on. Double-click takes the whole screen.
- Editing happens in its own window, sized to the shot.
- Select-and-move: arrows, boxes and captions can be selected, dragged, recolored, resized or deleted after the fact.
- Captions have their own size, scaled to the shot by default, and double-clicking one reopens it for editing.
- Cropping shows the selection's size and an explicit Apply, after which what you see is what exports.
- Recognize text, copy the image and save-as are available from the editor itself.
- Collage: stitch several images into one in a grid, row, column or free canvas — images can also be dropped in from the desktop.
- Text recognition runs on this machine; nothing is uploaded.

Fixes:
- Checking for updates in the app reports what it found, and updating from inside the app works.
- Text recognition no longer makes the app stop responding: it runs in the background, no longer covers the desktop while it works, and reports a timeout instead of waiting indefinitely.
- Keep-awake actually keeps the display on; it previously only stopped the machine from sleeping.
- Connecting in rule mode works again.
- Per-app routing takes effect.
- The capture and text-recognition shortcuts respond.
- The HTTPS decryption page no longer claims the certificate has not been generated.
- Encrypted DNS lookups and the CDN probe work on machines missing a root certificate.
- The keep-awake duration is honored.
- Network automation rules that match on the Wi-Fi name now trigger.
- Screenshots are saved where the settings row says they are.
- The tray node menu shows and switches the current node, and quitting asks about keeping the proxy when set to do so.

macOS and Android

No platform-specific changes this time — see the All platforms section above; the About and Help pages were also refreshed.

item.title: v1.83.0723
item.description:
本次更新（1.83.0723）：
- 修复小组件「本月流量」统计异常偏大的问题：流量现在跨应用启动持续准确累计（包含应用未打开期间产生的流量）。
- 升级后首次启动会把本月流量计数清零一次并重新开始累计，仅此一次。
- 完整变化可在 设置 → 关于 → 更新记录 中查看。

This update (1.83.0723):
- Fixed the widget's This Month traffic over-counting: totals now accumulate accurately across app launches (including traffic that moved while the app was closed).
- The first launch after this update resets the month's counter once, after which counting starts fresh — one time only.
- Full history is available under Settings → About → Changelog.

item.title: v1.53.0720
item.description:
本次更新（1.53.0720）汇总了距上次更新以来的全部新增：

修复
- 修复部分网络环境下全新安装时提示「已损坏」、需手动执行命令才能打开的问题；安装包现已随包自带公证票据，装完即用。

新增
- 更新记录：在 设置 → 关于 中查看每个版本的更新内容与变化历史；有新版本时先看更新内容再决定升级。
- 网络工具箱：连通性 / DNS 查询 / CDN 探测。
- HTTPS 抓包与改写：本机解密、查看并按规则改写请求与响应。
- 网络自动化：按 Wi-Fi 网络或网络条件自动切换规则，支持强制门户检测。
- 翻译：划词（⇧⌘T）、语音（⇧⌘V）、视频（系统声音）翻译，均在本机运行。
- 截图标注：区域 / 窗口截图的标注编辑器，含拼图、OCR、录屏。
- 跨设备局域网共享：配对码升级为 128 位密钥，文件传输进度 / 取消 / 批量操作。

改进
- 规则集改为按需在线下载并本地加载，页面显示各自的更新时间与来源。
- 规则数据的「刚更新」标记改为仅在更新后短暂显示，随后自动隐藏。
- 证书管理与信任设置、小组件跨端修复与自愈。

隐私
- 新增可关闭的匿名安装统计：仅随机安装 ID、版本号、平台三项，默认开启，可在 设置 → 关于 随时关闭。所有功能均在本机运行。
---
This update (1.53.0720) rolls up everything new since your last update:

Fixed
- Fixed a fresh-install "app is damaged" error on some networks that required a manual command to open; the build now carries its notarization ticket, so it just works after install.

New
- Changelog: see what each version changed in Settings → About; when an update is available, read its notes before choosing to upgrade.
- Network toolbox: reachability, DNS lookup, and CDN probe.
- HTTPS inspect & rewrite: decrypt, inspect, and rewrite requests and responses locally by rule.
- Network automation: switch rules by Wi-Fi network or network condition, with captive-portal detection.
- Translation: select-text (⇧⌘T), voice (⇧⌘V), and video (system audio), all on-device.
- Screenshot annotation: an editor for region/window captures, with collage, OCR, and screen recording.
- Cross-device LAN sharing: pairing code upgraded to a 128-bit secret; transfer progress, cancel, and batch actions.

Improved
- Rule sets are now downloaded on demand and loaded locally, each showing its own update time and source.
- The rule-data "just updated" flag now shows briefly right after a refresh and then hides on its own.
- Certificate management and trust settings; cross-platform widget fixes and self-healing.

Privacy
- New optional anonymous install statistics: just a random install ID, version, and platform — on by default, switchable off any time in Settings → About. Everything runs on your device.
